title: IPC Receive
text: Receive data from either core while using separate model for each core, 2 outputs, {Data type} sets Type of data to be received; {Source}, {Channel}, {Data length} sets the size of data to be received, {Enable blocking} sets the if Core must wait to read data and {Sample time} sets the interval at which block reads data. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Source
params.values: Source selected to receive data C28x (CPU1/CPU2)/CPU1 (default) | ARM Cortex-M4 (CM)/CPU2

params.name: Data type
params.values: Type of data to be received uint16 (default) | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | int32 | uint32 | boolean

params.name: Data length
params.values: Size of data to be received 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Enable blocking
params.values: Specify if Core must wait to read data off (default) | on

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Interval at which block reads data 0.001 (default) | –1 | positive scalar
